fact: In June 2026 a UN Economic Commission for Africa-supported national data governance assessment, followed by workshops with 21 institutions, found gaps in Congo's interoperability frameworks, technical standards and institutional coordination, and on 15 October 2026 the digital task force steering committee set interoperability work between the revenue agencies and land services to deliver from 2027.
title: Congo : la numérisation de l'administration face au défi de l'interopérabilité
